verdict.rationale: Rollbar's docs mention project-level 'access tokens' that are encrypted and API-manageable [rollbar-docs-16, rollbar-docs-14], which could in principle be issued per-agent, but there is no documentation of fine-grained scopes, expiry, or agent-specific credential issuance. Community evidence also flags that default project tokens are standing, non-expiring, read-privileged, and not opt-in, undercutting a true least-privilege posture [rollbar-comm-1]. missing for 10: explicit scope/permission granularity documentation, agent-specific credential workflow, expiration/rotation controls, and confirmation that default tokens follow least-privilege by default.
